credits.title: DNK
credits.overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

credits.title: Summer Holidays
credits.overview: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

credits.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
credits.overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

credits.title: Irumudi
credits.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

credits.title: Adhey Neevu Adhey Nenu
credits.overview: Sagar, a software engineer, and his wife Sri Valli live in a gated community in Hyderabad. As work consumes Sagar, a lonely Sri Valli is drawn to Karthik, a charming new neighbour in town on a project from Canada, until shocking truths about her husband surface and a crime turns all three lives upside down.

credits.title: Katha Kamamishu
credits.overview: The movie is about a family in a small town and how a small issue changes their relationships...

credits.title: Goodachari
credits.overview: Gopi, is the son of an ex-RAW agent Raghuveer. Brought up by his uncle Sathya, he wants to be an agent just like his father and uncle. But Satya wants him to lead a normal life and not be killed like his father was. What happens in Gopi’s life that turns everything upside down?
